# Structure

- `stock_reports/<TICKER>/` — one folder per ticker; files `report_<TICKER>_<timestamp>.pdf`; one PDF per ticker: workbench sync keeps only the latest and deletes older PDFs in the folder (history lives in git).
- `studies/<domain>/<slug>/` — domains: `alternative_data`, `credit`, `crypto`, `fundamentals`, `liquidity`, `macro` (largest), `market_internals`, `options`, `sentiment`, `space`, `stats`, `technical-reports`, `volatility`.
- `docs/` — `context/` (this map), `context.md` (Claude Projects primer), `context-prompt.md`.
